high_level_description: The image shows the back of a white t-shirt laid out against a starry space background, giving the impression that it is floating in space. The t-shirt features a playful and whimsical design with the text "I NEED MY SPACE" prominently displayed in large, bold letters. The letters are stylized with a mix of black and blue colors, adding a vibrant touch to the design. The phrase "I NEED MY SPACE" is creatively integrated into the design, with the word "MY" cleverly designed to resemble an astronaut floating in space.
